meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: Всё получилось = it all worked out. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to turn out, to work out', paired with 'получаться'.

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor

examples.text: Классный из тебя мэр получится, Самсон.

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'слабиться'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to relax', paired with 'расслабляться'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'валить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'take off, dump'.
